ei.title: 36번 — Agricultural Land Use and Global Food Demand

fullPassage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor. However, the growing global population will always demand more food. It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991.

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. Over the millennia, continuous (A)[____ / restrictions] have boosted agricultural (B)[productivity / pollution] while reducing manual (C)[labor / profit]. However, the growing global population will always demand more food. It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① innovations — productivity — labor: 원문 일치
❌ ② restrictions — 제한은 혁신의 반의어
❌ ③ pollution — 오염은 생산성과 다름
❌ ④ profit — 이익은 노동과 다른 개념

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. It is (A)[____ / denied] that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small (B)[portion / majority] of the Earth's surface is (C)[suitable / harmful] for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 2050년까지 인구가 증가할 것으로 전망(projected)된다. 지구 표면의 작은 부분(portion)만이 농업에 적합(suitable)하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ projected — portion — suitable: 원문 일치
❌ ① denied — 부정은 전망의 반의어
❌ ② majority — 대다수는 portion의 반의어
❌ ④ harmful — 해로운은 suitable의 반의어
det.tip: projected(전망된), a small portion(작은 부분), suitable for(~에 적합한)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 작물이 재배(cultivated)되었다. 혁신이 생산성을 높였다(boosted). 요인들이 토지 이용에 영향을 미친다(influence).

❌ ① eliminated — 제거는 재배의 반의어
❌ ③ hindered — 방해는 boosted의 반의어
